verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents strict typing, type-checked APIs, or schema validation that would let a coding agent catch its own mistakes at build time. Multi-language availability, code-first Python definitions, "controlled output" in the Task API, and runtime evaluation via adk eval are adjacent features, not build-time type or schema checking. This is an applicable axis for an agent framework, so absent evidence means none.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on strict typing and schema validation so a coding agent catches its own mistakes at build time
